title: Browser build not possible from Windows PC
symptom: When trying to run a browser build on a Windows PC, a popup appears that redirects the user to the File Manager Plus app in the Android Play Store, preventing the browser build from being used outside of Android.
cause: The issue is caused by a code block that checks if the hostname is not '127.0.0.1' or 'localhost' and then shows an alert and redirects to the Play Store. The maintainer explains that a webserver is necessary for the Google OAuth callback.
fix: Run the browser build from within a webserver, as the maintainer states 'read different section based on where you run it' and explains that the webserver is necessary for the Google OAuth callback.
evidence_quote: read different section based on where you run it
